name: Spatchcock roast chicken with potatoes and garlic
title: Roast chicken

steps.text: Oven on to 200C; racks in the middle and just above.
Halve the potatoes lengthways, slice the tops off the garlic bulbs, into a roasting tray, season, 1 tsp oil.
Cut down the back of the chicken and open it flat; rub butter, salt and pepper all over.
Potatoes on the bottom shelf, chicken straight on the shelf above, onions on top of the chicken.
Turn the potatoes; brush the chicken with juices using the rosemary.
Turn the potatoes again and baste.
Chicken out to rest. Squeeze onions and garlic out of their skins, toss through the potatoes.

prep: Tie the rosemary into a brush
equipment: a big sharp knife and board
